items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: they had more Morphets around there and they had men, uh, Morphets, used to dress up like women.

ctx.x: And did they have many jockeys around there?
Oh, well, down there, yeah, they had, they said, bum around there but they had more Morphets around there and they had men, uh, Morphets, used to dress up like women.
I mean jockeys that rode horses.
